about: No guided sequence takes exist (data/sequences is missing), so performances are SPLICED from the single-sign recordings: an idle lead-in, each sign held 1.6-2.6 s, 0.4-1.2 s of idle between signs (real transitions between seals are not in the data), 3 s of idle after. Windows are random; the held-out validation recording is used where a sign has one (idle, rasengan_palm). Everything else comes from TRAIN recordings, see 'signs' per jutsu.
